Please search [existing issues and feature requests](https://github.com/rhodan412/ActionBarProfiles/issues) first, then describe the new behavior you would like.

## Versions and context

- Action Bar Profiles version:
- WoW Retail version/build:
- Published CurseForge download or development copy:
- Character class/specialization, if relevant:

## What problem would this solve?

Describe the current workflow or limitation. An example of when you encounter it is helpful.

## Proposed behavior

Explain what the addon should do and how a player would use it. If the request affects profiles, say whether it belongs in **Save**, **Use**, a profile checkbox, settings, chat commands, or somewhere else.

## Examples and edge cases

Include sample profile setups, screenshots, or expected behavior for other characters/specializations if useful. Note how this should interact with existing actions, talents, macros, pet actions, or key bindings.

## Alternatives or workarounds

What have you tried, and why does it not meet the need?

## Related requests

Link similar or related issues if you found any.
